title: Questionnaire Translator + Evidence Token for Sales Engineers
creator: Alex Kim
description: Problem: Sales and SEs frequently spend 6+ business days compiling SIG/CAIQ answers for prospects. Legal reviews are an unpredictable bottleneck and answers are often inconsistent across accounts. This ticket scopes a product experiment to let SEs generate a customer-ready CAIQ response bundle with a machine-assisted 'translator' and a verifiable evidence token that short-circuits low-risk reviews.
goal: Reduce time-to-deliver security questionnaire responses to <= 2 business days for low/medium-risk customers; increase automated response rate (no legal edit) to 35% within the pilot cohort.
solution_overview: Build a Questionnaire Translator microservice that maps incoming SIG/CAIQ questions to canonical answer snippets and ranked evidence assets. Each output bundle includes: (1) derived answers with provenance and a freshness/confidence score; (2) an Evidence Token (short URL + signature + TTL) that points to the underlying artifacts (design docs, SOC/attestations, config screenshots). The translator uses embeddings to match question semantics and a lightweight rules engine to route borderline items to Legal. SE UI: a composer that shows confidence, allows quick edits, and logs decisions to an audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Translator returns a ranked answer + evidence list for 90% of SIG questions in the pilot dataset
Confidence score correlates with Legal review outcome (>= 0.7 confidence -> legal no-edit 80% of time)
Evidence Token can be validated (signature and TTL) by recipients and links to Drive/Confluence artifacts
SE time-to-first-draft reduced to <= 2 business days in pilot cohort
Audit log captures SE edits and Legal overrides with links to PR/changes

2025-11-20: SE composer alpha + Evidence Token proof-of-concept
2025-11-30: Pilot rollout to 6 SEs and two enterprise customers
2025-12-14: Measure results and decide go/no-go for scaling
implementation_notes: Architecture: translator service exposes /translate endpoint, uses vector DB for semantic matching and a Redis rules cache for fast routing. Evidence Token is an HMAC-signed URL with a short identifier that points to a read-only snapshot stored in a secured Drive folder. Engineering to evaluate storing embeddings in existing vector infra vs ephemeral Weaviate instance for experiment. Need an audit export to onboarding dashboard (CSV + BigQuery).
metrics: % of answered questionnaires without Legal edits
False positive routing (items sent to Legal that could have been auto-approved)
risks_and_mitigation: Legal rejects auto-answers -> mitigation: conservative confidence threshold and explicit triage to Legal
Evidence token link leakage -> mitigation: short TTL, pre-signed read-only artifacts, and audit of recipients
Inconsistent canonical snippets -> mitigation: single-source-of-truth in Confluence and owner for each domain
notes: Experiment includes a simple pricing lever: provide 25 free evidence token generations per account per quarter during pilot, then test a credit model charged to seat bundles. This ticket focuses on product mechanics; pricing experiments tracked in sibling ticket after pilot readout.
